_comment: Single source of truth for delegation-enforcer model classification. Both ~/.claude/hooks/delegation-enforcer.sh and ~/.config/opencode/plugins/delegation-enforcer.js load this file. Tier IDs (high/mid/budget) are stable — display labels are user-facing.

trinity._comment: Per-slot models for both runtimes. `oc` writes to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (.model). `cc` writes to ~/.claude/settings.json (.model) — bare aliases work in Claude Code (opus/sonnet/haiku). Sonnet is brain because opus is too expensive/rate-limited in this user's context.

selection._comment: Used by `trinity auto`: pick `brain` slot when credit ≥ threshold, else `fallback` slot. Sonnet on OpenCode isn't always stable, so dropping to haiku (mid slot) at low credit is more reliable than burning what's left on flaky brain calls. `enabled` toggles all delegation-enforcer logic. `active_slot` records the last slot set by `trinity`.

high.label: brain
high.behavior: warn on Edit/Write/Bash with savings estimate; ledger; context7 nudge; scratchpad observe
